source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

carry.quote: Makes the stats on every item you buy stronger, so it rewards hitting your item spikes on time. Bloatware grows with each item slot you fill, favoring long games.
carry.issue: 'hit item spikes on time' advice unsupported; Demiurge just boosts item stats
carry.rewrite: Makes the stats on every item you buy stronger, so it scales as your build fills out. Bloatware adds a little damage and damage reduction per item you own.

support.quote: Extra health lets you stand in front and land Hoarfrost and Cryoseism without dying first. Regenerative Tissue refills you between fights, so you can stay in lane longer.
support.issue: Regenerative Tissue is slow regen after avoiding hero damage, not a refill
support.rewrite: Extra health lets you stand in front and land Hoarfrost and Cryoseism without dying first. Regenerative Tissue slowly regenerates health once you avoid hero damage for a few seconds.

jungle.quote: Extra health and size make you a sturdier front line. Pull with Riplash and hold them in Skewer; Regenerative Tissue refills you between camps when no hero is hitting you.
jungle.issue: Regenerative Tissue is slow regen after a delay, not a refill
jungle.rewrite: Extra health and size make you a sturdier front line. Pull with Riplash and hold them in Skewer; Regenerative Tissue regenerates health between camps once heroes stop hitting you.

jungle.quote: Hitting a hero under 30% health fires missiles that follow them through walls, adding a little damage. Wind-Rider's attack speed after Heaven's Fury can add missiles.
jungle.issue: missiles don't follow; Wind-Rider alone not shown to add missiles
jungle.rewrite: Hitting a hero under 30% health fires a few small true-damage missiles that fly through walls. Extra missiles need more bonus attack speed, which Wind-Rider after Heaven's Fury helps build.

jungle.quote: You grow stronger over time and with every takedown, and Fallen Grace already sends you diving for kills. Masterpiece stacks damage and speed on kills, so chain resets in fights.
jungle.issue: 'chain resets' is jargon; Masterpiece resets nothing
jungle.rewrite: You grow stronger over time and with every takedown, and Fallen Grace cuts your cooldowns after takedowns. Masterpiece stacks damage and speed on kills, so keep fighting while it lasts.

offlane.quote: Every cast weakens nearby enemy heroes' damage, so stay close and keep weaving Rushing Beat and Line Tempo. Allegro means more dashes; Harmonic Currents refunds health and mana each cast.
offlane.issue: Harmonic Currents restores a small part of missing health/mana, not a refund
offlane.rewrite: Every cast weakens nearby enemy heroes' damage, so stay close and keep weaving Rushing Beat and Line Tempo. Harmonic Currents restores a little missing health and mana each cast.

jungle.quote: Your items give more stats and their effects hit harder. Rush your core purchases and lean on your build; Bloatware adds damage and toughness with every item you finish.
jungle.issue: 'rush your core' advice unsupported by Demiurge
jungle.rewrite: Your items give more stats and their effects hit harder, so each item counts for more. Bloatware adds damage and toughness with every item you finish.

midlane.quote: Spamming Particle Shredder and Dread Nova keeps your mana flowing and pays gold off hero damage. Poke constantly in lane; Runic Focus rewards staying high on mana.
midlane.issue: overstates small stacking regen; Particle Shredder drains mana, contradicting Runic Focus advice
midlane.rewrite: Each cast adds a little mana regeneration, and ability damage on heroes pays extra gold. Poke with Dread Nova in lane; Runic Focus rewards keeping your mana bar high.

support.quote: Leaves extra burn after each ability hit, so Untamed Growth and Bramble Patch keep enemies hurting. Tithe of Death refills mana and adds ability haste on takedowns.

support.rewrite: Leaves extra burn after each ability hit, so Untamed Growth and Bramble Patch keep enemies hurting. Tithe of Death restores some mana and adds ability haste on takedowns.
